_readme: Reviewed exceptions to the OpenCC tw2sp conversion used for the Simplified Chinese display dictionary and catalogues (docs/post-mvp/design/simplified-chinese.md §5.2). Every entry has a reason. A Mainland-usage reviewer edits this file; scripts/i18n/build_hans.py applies it and `pnpm i18n:review-hans` lists the effect.

文字大小.reason: protected: tw2sp gives 文本大小; the text-size setting is 文字大小

資料品質.reason: the quality of the data (a coefficient in the computation), not of a person's information

文字檔.reason: tw2sp gives 文本档; a plain-text file is 文本文件

介面.reason: tw2sp gives 接口, which means an API; a user interface is 界面

回饋.reason: tw2sp gives 回馈 ('to repay'); feedback is 反馈 in Mainland usage

帳號.reason: Mainland usage writes 账号, not 帐号

益著.reason: protected: tw2sp gives 益着; 著 here is zhù ('conspicuous'), as in 功益著 'the effect is the more marked'

紀錄.reason: tw2sp gives 纪录, which means a (sports) record; a saved entry is 记录

線上.reason: tw2sp gives 在线 (online); in the point locations it is anatomical: 正中線上 is 'on the midline', so 正中线上

複製.reason: tw2sp gives 拷贝; the Mainland interface word for copy is 复制

資料.reason: tw2sp gives 数据; here 資料 mostly means a person's own information or reference material (基本资料, 资料来源), which Mainland usage keeps as 资料

連線.reason: tw2sp gives 连接 ('connect'); the line joining two landmarks is 连线 in Mainland anatomy texts

進階.reason: tw2sp gives 高端 ('high-end'); an advanced level is 进阶

闢著.reason: tw2sp gives 辟着; in the 《素問》 passage (則剛木辟著) 著 is zhù and stays 著

離線.reason: tw2sp gives 脱机, which is dated; Mainland applications say 离线

預設.reason: tw2sp gives 缺省, which is unusual in an application; Mainland interfaces say 默认

common.lang.zh-Hant.reason: each language is named in its own script in the language switch

common.lang.zh-Hans.reason: each language is named in its own script in the language switch
